body.statement:
Let \(q=|\mathcal I|\), \(p=nN\), \(R_N=2^{N(N-1)}\), and retain \(s=(q+N+1)2^{8N^2}\), \(d=4N^3\), and \(\tau=(\lambda+1)2^{8N^2}\) from Theorem \(\texttt{thm:effective-population-compiler}\).  Put \(s_{\leq}=R_Ns\) and
\[
 \mathsf B_{\leq}(N,q,\lambda)
 =R_N(\tau+1)^2(s_{\leq}+1)^{(p+1)(p+N+1)+1}
 (d+1)^{c_{\mathrm{qe}}(p+1)(p+N+1)}.                                 \tag{23}
\]
There is a terminating exact compiler deciding \(\operatorname{Cover}_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(G,H)\) within \(\mathsf B_{\leq}(N,q,\lambda)\) bit operations and zero-allowed equivalence within \(2\mathsf B_{\leq}(N,q,\lambda)\) bit operations.  It enumerates the zero-allowed equivalence class of \(G\) modulo latent relabeling within
\[
 R_N\bigl(2\mathsf B_{\leq}(N,q,\lambda)+\ell!N^2\bigr)               \tag{24}
\]
bit operations, apart from fixed linear-time encoding overhead.  Its output is a finite sign-cell certificate and contains neither a structural-coefficient quantifier nor a source-law quantifier.
body.proof_tex:
For each spanning subgraph \(F\subseteq G\), reuse the exact compiler's quantifier-free formula \(\operatorname{Dom}_F(C)\).  For each \(K\subseteq H\), reuse its witness formula \(\Theta_{K,f}(C,D,a)\), with the domain clause changed only from \(\operatorname{Dom}_H(D)\) to \(\operatorname{Dom}_K(D)\).  The clause required for this fixed \(F\) is
\[
 \forall C\;\left[
 \operatorname{Dom}_F(C)\Longrightarrow
 \exists(D,a)\bigvee_{K\subseteq H}\bigvee_{U,W,f}
 \Theta_{K,f}(C,D,a)
 \right].                                                              \tag{25}
\]
The finite disjunction may be placed inside the one existential block because every disjunct uses the same padded \(D\)-matrix and at most \(N\) padded scalar variables.  By Definition \(\texttt{def:downward-closed-cover}\), the conjunction of (25) over \(F\subseteq G\) is exactly \(\operatorname{Cover}_{\mathcal I}^{\leq}(G,H)\).  Theorem \(\texttt{thm:zero-allowed-coupled-equivalence}\) proves that its truth is equivalent to zero-allowed law-set containment.

There are at most \(R_N\) choices of \(F\) and at most \(R_N\) choices of \(K\).  For a fixed \(F\), the added \(K\)-disjunction multiplies the exact compiler's number of recorded polynomial atoms by at most \(R_N\), so it uses at most \(s_{\leq}=R_Ns\) atoms.  It introduces no new real variable, and its polynomials are copied from the exact charts; their degree remains at most \(d\) and their coefficient bit length at most \(\tau\).  Thus Lemma \(\texttt{lem:effective-real-quantifier-elimination}\) decides one formula (25) within
\[
 (\tau+1)^2(s_{\leq}+1)^{(p+1)(p+N+1)+1}
 (d+1)^{c_{\mathrm{qe}}(p+1)(p+N+1)}
\]
bit operations.  Running it for all at most \(R_N\) source strata gives (23).  The elimination output retains zero sign conditions and algebraic sample encodings, so concatenating the at most \(R_N\) certificates gives a finite certificate for the conjunction, including every lower-dimensional incidence.

Two directed runs decide equality.  Finally enumerate the \(R_N\) labeled loopless candidate graphs and, for each accepted candidate, canonicalize under the \(\ell!\) latent-label permutations at cost at most \(\ell!N^2\).  This proves (24).  Exact mixing realization removed \(B\), unrestricted source-partition containment removed all source laws, and only the explicitly displayed mixing, scaling, and finite chart variables remain in (25).  Hence the algorithm terminates with the claimed representation and is not black-box elimination of the original structural-existence formula.
body.justification: The theorem reuses the exact sign charts inside the finite downward-closure disjunction and gives a conservative explicit complexity bound.
body.consumer: The fixed-latent zero-allowed equivalence class can be enumerated modulo latent relabeling without returning to structural-coefficient or source-law feasibility.
